description: Returns the approximate areas of a vertical (9:16) video frame that the app interface covers on Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Stories: unsafe margins in pixels and percent, the safe rectangle for text, the position of the right-hand button column and short placement guidance. Values are measured on 1080x1920 and scaled to the given frame size.

platform.description: Vertical video platform: 'reels' (Instagram Reels), 'tiktok', 'shorts' (YouTube Shorts), 'story' (Instagram Stories) or 'all' (the strictest margins of all four combined).

name: get_safe_zone
title: Get vertical video safe zone
